subject: Proposal: Accelerator credit smoothing & monthly bucket structure
messages:
From: Danielle Park <danielle@liftlabs.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi@liftlabs.org>, partnerships@liftlabs.org
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator credits — smoothing ask and monthly caps

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising for our cohort apps. We ran the budget model with our founders and have a request: the promo credits in the program are front-loaded (50% quarter 1, 25% Q2, 25% Q3) and a handful of teams will spike usage in different months depending on their demos and partner integrations.

Can Redwood offer a smoothing option so the total promotional pool can be reallocated across months (up to +/- 30% month-to-month) instead of the default tranche schedule? Specifically:
- Total pool per cohort: 250,000 tokens equivalent (as you quoted)
- Request: ability to move up to 30% of any month’s allocation to a different month within the same cohort window

We’re not asking to change the overall economics, just to avoid situations where founders burn out their initial tranche in week three and then can’t demo in month two. If helpful I can share a simple calendar of projected demo peaks.

Two constraints on our side: 1) finance wants a clear audit line for how credits are consumed per company, and 2) we’d prefer the smoothing to be opt-in for each cohort.

Appreciate a quick read — Ravi and I are hoping to finalize terms with legal this week so we can publish the program page.

Best,
Danielle

--
Danielle Park
Director, Partnerships — Lift Labs Accelerator
Danielle.Park@liftlabs.org | 415-555-0199

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@liftlabs.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — smoothing ask and monthly caps

Hi Danielle — thanks for the clear ask and context. I spoke to product and finance this morning and we can offer a controlled smoothing policy with the following guardrails:

Proposal (summary):
- Cohort-level pool remains fixed.
- Admins (Lift Labs) can reallocate up to +/- 30% of a given month’s token allocation to another month in the same cohort window (no more than two reallocations per cohort).
- Redemptions will still be tracked at the company level; reallocated tokens retain the original company attribution.
- Any overage beyond the cohort pool will bill at standard PAYG rates unless pre-authorized.

Operational notes:
- We’ll surface the smoothing tool in the Console under the cohort settings; admins will need to authorize reallocations (two-step confirmation).
- We’ll export an audit CSV for each cohort showing original allocation, reallocations, and per-company consumption.

Attached is a short proposal doc and a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can line up legal and implementation milestones. Ben — can you confirm the billing language we’d need in an MSA addendum? Marissa — can you own the console UX for the admin flow and timeline for rollout?

If this looks OK I can draft an addendum we can attach to the MSA. We should be able to support this for the Sep cohort if we sign by next Friday.

Best,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_Accelerator_Credit_Smoothing_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Danielle Park <danielle@liftlabs.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — smoothing ask and monthly caps

Thanks Hannah. Quick notes from finance/legal POV:
- We can accept the smoothing concept but need explicit language that: 1) the cohort pool is contractual and non-transferrable outside the cohort, and 2) any reallocation is tracked and auditable at the company level (this aligns with your finance constraint, Danielle).
- For the MSA addendum we’ll use a simple Schedule outlining the cohort ID, total pool, allowed reallocation percentage, and the governance process (who signs off).
- Billing: overages will be charged to Lift Labs unless you prefer per-company invoicing. If Lift Labs prefers a consolidated invoice we can do that with line items per company (adds 5–7 business days to reconciliation).

Follow-up question for Danielle: is consolidated billing to Lift Labs preferable or do you want each company on their own card? This affects whether we need invoicing line-items in the addendum.

Ben
Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@liftlabs.org>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — smoothing ask and monthly caps

Hi all — looping in a quick timeline and operations checklist (I attached the MAP workbook):
- Day 0: Sign addendum (MSA + smoothing Schedule) — legal approvals done by both sides
- Day 1–2: Redwood config: enable cohort smoothing and create audit export
- Day 3: Lift Labs admin training call (30m) — how to authorize reallocations
- Day 10: Dry run with first pilot company (move up to 20% from month 1 to month 2)

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_LiftLabs.xlsx

Note on billing model: Danielle, if you want consolidated billing to Lift Labs we’ll set up a consolidated account and bill one invoice; our ops team will need a billing contact and PO if required.

Marissa
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Danielle Park <danielle@liftlabs.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — smoothing ask and monthly caps

Hi team — this all looks good and would solve the founders’ demo problem. Answers to Ben’s question: we prefer consolidated billing to Lift Labs for cohort admin simplicity. Ravi and I will ask finance to provide a PO if needed.

Next steps on our side:
- I’ll get the PO + a signed addendum back to you by EOD Friday.
- Please send the DocuSign link for the MSA addendum (we’ll route to legal).
- We’ll schedule the 30m admin training for Tue, 25 Aug (Ravi and I + one engineer).

Thanks — excited to get this live for the Sep cohort.

Best,
Danielle
